title: On-Demand Store Auditor
description_html:
Hetal Retail is hiring an on-demand store auditor in Nashua, NH 03060. You visit an assigned store, complete a short checklist in the Hetal app, and submit photos from the sales floor before you leave.

The work is part-time and on site. You choose the visits that fit your day. Most audits take less than an hour once you are inside the store.

What you will do

  • Travel to the assigned store in Nashua
  • Follow the checklist in the Hetal app
  • Check shelf, display, and price details against the task
  • Submit the visit before you leave the store

What you need

  • You are 18 or older and authorized to work in the United States
  • You have a smartphone that can run the Hetal app
  • You can reach stores in the Nashua 03060 area on your own

Pay is $18 per hour, paid through the Hetal app after the visit is approved.

title: On-Demand Store Auditor

  • You can install and use the Hetal app on your phone
  • You can travel to stores in the Hackensack 07601 area

Pay is $18 per hour, paid through the Hetal app after the visit is approved.
